name: Shiva 'Persinger Session' (7 chirp applications, counter-clockwise ring)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva software, launcher persinger_batch); Murphy attributes the session to M.A. Persinger, but no Persinger paper describing it has been found
summary: Murphy's Shiva session that he says Persinger 'developed for training in psi skills' and that 'enhances whatever spiritual technique a person works with': seven chirp applications with silences in between, stepped counter-clockwise around an 8-position ring, 43 min. The vendor gives only this structure; block lengths, silences, step times and the 40 Hz sine that stands in for the chirp are this project's choices.
setting: Dark, quiet room. Murphy: 'Don't do spiritual practices or psychic exercises during Shiva Sessions ... Daydreaming is better than meditation.' For perception during the session he advises geomagnetic quiet (K 0-2).
schedule: Weekly at most. For skill training Murphy advises running it when the K-index is 4 ('unsettled') and starting mental or psychic exercises two days later, for three days (elsewhere: practise 3-5 days after).
notes: The vendor gives only the structure: 'seven unique applications of the chirp signal with silent sections in between ... The session is about 43 minutes long' (experiment_signals.htm). Its research page ties the chirp to the lab's chirp-sequence configurations (shiva_evidence.htm); which seven are used is not published. This project's choices: 7 blocks of 5 min, 80 s of silence after each of the first six, and a plain 40 Hz sine for the chirp. Blocks 1 to 6 hold each coil for 10 to 20, 12 to 22 ... 20 to 30 ms in 2-ms steps, after a lecture example with no unit named. Block 7 is the lab's +20 ms configuration: 100 ms on the first coil and 20 ms more on each next, up to 240 ms (Richards 2002 p.4 [674], Table 1). Lab runs of the Shiva software used other tables: 20 to 6 ms and 100 to 30 ms (Saroka 2010 p.5 [470]), 100 ms plus 20 ms (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]). The eight coils sit on the vendor's Shiva ring and fire one at a time, counter-clockwise seen from above. Shiva has a coil pair at each position; one coil keeps the timing and covers about half the arc. Field at the lab ring: 5 to 10 uT at the scalp (Richards 2002 p.3 [673]), 0.5 to 1.5 uT near the scalp (Tsang 2004 p.5 [1187]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. The vendor says to start at 50% volume and raise it each session, so start low. The psi and spiritual claims rest on Persinger-lab studies and testimonials; the DeepFocus report that Murphy's blog calls an independent replication is a two-page testimonial without data, methods or controls. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Weekly at most; not back to back with another session. Stop on distress; not for people with epilepsy.
